summary: Build a calibrated evidence graph that supports concrete release and escalation decisions.

items.text: Define evidence requirements by risk class: routine tasks may need tests and provenance, while security or production changes require independent review and deployment telemetry.
Use shadow evaluation and periodic blinded human samples to detect evaluator drift before changing approval policy.
Make each trust signal explainable and separately inspectable; compute summaries only as navigation aids, never as the sole release gate.
